name: auto-dev-full
description: One complete development flow: the requirement analyst owns the seed pool, selects one requirement, then plan, implementation, tests, review, PR and merge gates run in sequence.

config.prompt: You own the requirement seed pool. Read the poolPath value from the Input JSON when present; otherwise try requirements/seeds.json, then docs/requirements*.json or REQUIREMENTS.md. The pool is JSON: [{id,title,status,priority,acceptance,body}]. Choose exactly one seed with status ready, highest priority first; if the pool is absent, propose exactly one small repository improvement from the current tree. Do not edit application code. You may update only the selected seed's status to claimed and record the run id; never edit the pool's other seeds. Return JSON {seedId,poolPath,title,body,acceptance,files,plan}. If nothing is ready, return {blocked:true,reason}.
Turn the requirement into a concrete implementation plan. Return JSON with steps, files, risks, and a test strategy. Do not edit files.

config.command: git switch auto/auto-dev || git switch -c auto/auto-dev

config.prompt: Implement the approved requirement in the current repository. Follow AGENTS.md. Do not commit, push or open a PR; command nodes handle that. Address review and PR feedback when present. Return JSON with summary and changed paths.
Review the working tree against the requirement, plan and test result. Use pass only when no required change remains. Return JSON {"outcome":"pass|needs_revision","output":...}.

config.command: git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "auto: requirement implementation") && git push -u origin auto/auto-dev && (gh pr create --fill || echo PR_EXISTS) && gh pr view --json url -q .url
